data.one_liner: A Flutter package to add touch ripple effect and touch feedback to any widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides TouchRippleEffect and TouchFeedback widgets that wrap arbitrary children and render customizable ripple animations upon user taps or long presses.
use_when: You want to add custom touch ripple effects to non-Material widgets or custom containers.
You need touch feedback animations with configurable duration, color, and border radius.
avoid_when: You are using standard Material widgets like InkWell or TextButton which already include built-in ripple effects.
strengths: Simple API with clear TouchRippleEffect and TouchFeedback widgets.
Supports customizable ripple color, duration, border radius, and shadows.
Handles both onTap and onLongPress gestures.
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to the built-in Material InkResponse and InkWell system.
data.minimal_example:
TouchRippleEffect(
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
  rippleColor: Colors.white60,
  onTap: () {},
  child: Container(
    width: 110,
    height: 50,
    alignment: Alignment.center,
    color: Colors.pink,
    child: Text("On Click"),
  ),
)
